notes.title: April 28, 2022 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Along with the Steam update, we have fixed a few bugs and made some changes.

[h3]■ Updates[/h3]
We have added a new sixth stage called "Twilight Sanctuary". You can access it by heading to the wharf located in the "Qing Dynasty". 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35555991/72ebcbb524e4396c6d58657e2dc768902dcd1e1f.jpg[/img]

We have added one "Sources of Earth" to each map, six new "Sources of Earth" total. 

[h3]■ Gameplay[/h3]
Added "Midnight Sanctuary" to the Stats tab in the Pause Menu.

[h3]■ Others[/h3]
Changed the required amount of "Sources of Earth" in the achievement "A Full Bag" from 244 to 250. *Those who have already unlocked the achievement will not be affected*
Added a fade to black transition after the end of a cutscene

[h3]■ Midnight Sanctuary[/h3]
This area is for airships only. Utilize "Soaring Fireworks" and "Falling Fireworks" wisely, and make it into the depths of the Midnight Sanctuary within the time limit.

Thank you very much for playing TASOMACHI: Behind the Twilight and we hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Update: Added an acquisition statistics page for collectibles
notes.notes:
Dear Fans,
 
Thank you for playing TASOMACHI: Behind the Twilight.
This message is to inform you that a new update has gone live.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35555991/16c21bf34d0a8c609e2c5acd9858bbc2f15d49ac.jpg[/img]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an acquisition statistics page for collectibles to the pause menu.
[*]Added town maps to the pause menu which will become viewable upon clearing of twilight fog.
[*]Added new items to town shops. By purchasing these items, you will receive a hint for the Source of Earth locations in the form of a marker on the map.
[*]Added 8 new emotions for Yukumo. Perform emotions by pressing the “B” key on your keyboard or right directional button on your controller. Press again to stop performing emotions.
[*]Added option to hide photo mode UI.
[*]Added sound effect during startup of photo mode.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35555991/56601eae0e6f6781d6fd7680c886960136a43383.jpg[/img]

[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved twilight fog visuals.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where the Y-axis and X-axis reversal settings were not reflected properly in the camera operation during airship control when using controller.
[*]Fixed bug where some pause menu texts were not translated.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35555991/d030220f6b49c56329a9ccbe1d943377d7fd6589.jpg[/img]

[b]Others[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the unlock conditions of the Shopaholic achievements from 20 to 23. This will not affect players who have already unlocked said achievement.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35555991/ab976d16df645fc656a8706c67799e2c7facbad6.jpg[/img]

Again, thank you for your continued support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35555991/b6a1ed4eaf2ef08e1799dce310a73abfa54eb80f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update: Improvements to the collecting aspect of the game and other adjustments.
notes.notes:
Dear Fans,
 
Thank you for playing TASOMACHI: Behind the Twilight.
This message is to inform you that a new update has gone live.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Decreased the difficulty of the 1st, 4th and 6th Sacred Tree Sanctuary trials.
[*]When attempting the Twilight Sanctuary for the second time and onwards, the time limit will now be shown on screen. Also the event has been adjusted to end as soon as it is cleared even if there is time left.
[*]Added a Sign in each area which tells you how many Lanterns, Great view spots, Mailboxes, relics of the Sky, relics of the Earth you’ve collected.
[*]Added a Sign in each Sanctuary which tells you how many fragments of the Source of Earth you have collected.
[/list]
[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the design and visual effects of the teleporter.
[*]Changed the color of the airship.
[*]Changed the Sign icon.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where settings such as Y axis and X axis inversion were not being applied to the photo mode correctly.
[*]Fixed an issue where the camera position was not returning to the correct position after using the teleporter.
[*]Fixed an issue where you could enter the Library in Shiokaze Pier through unconventional means and become stuck in the room.
[/list]

[u]Points at which the Signs showing collectible item progression are added.[/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35555991/429d7c100fa7727390d511d7bf8c100a9f40bc57.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]After clearing the Ring Sanctuary: Lanterns, Great view spots and Sanctuary Source of Earth fragments. (Top 3 images)
[*]After clearing the Twilight Sanctuary: Mailboxes, relics of the Earth, relics of the Sky. (Bottom 2 images)
[/list]

Again, thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Mini Update: Gameplay quality of life improvements
notes.notes:
Dear Fans,
 
Thank you for playing TASOMACHI: Behind the Twilight.
This message is to inform you that a new update has gone live.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Pushed back the default camera distance when controlling Yukumo.
[*]Decreased camera rotation lag when controlling Yukumo.
[*]Slightly increased Yukumo’s running animation speed.
[*]Decreased camera rotation lag when controlling the airship.
[*]Increased the speed at which the airship turns in the camera direction.
[*]Decreased the overall difficulty of the Sacred Tree Sanctuary trials.
[*]Increased the time limit by 15 seconds when attempting the Twilight Sanctuary for the second time and onwards.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the airship camera sensitivity settings were not being correctly applied.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Photo Mode camera sensitivity settings were not being correctly applied.
[/list]
[u]*You do not have to format your Save data.[/u]

Again, thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Mini-update: Several fixes have been implemented to improve general gameplay.
notes.notes:
Dear Fans,
 
Thank you for playing TASOMACHI: Behind the Twilight.
This message is to inform you that a new update has gone live.

[h2]System[/h2]
[list]
[*] In order to avoid high graphic board loads, Vsync and a a 120FPS upper limit have been applied.
[*] Window Mode has been added. Window Mode can be toggled using F11.
[*] Bug preventing airship controls from functioning properly with inverted X-/Y-axis has been fixed.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Camera delay reduced when controlling Yukumo.
[*] Yukumo's model appeared to be slightly hovering over the ground; this has also been fixed.
[*] The location of the Source of Earth fragment that was buried in Holy Tree Sanctuary 5 has been adjusted.
[*] Fixed bug causing stacking when falling in certain parts of Shiokaze Pier.
[/list]

Again, thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Trial Ver. Release & Livestream Event for the Steam Game Festival!
notes.notes:
With the Spring 2021 full release of [i]TASOMACHI: Behind the Twilight[/i] on the horizon, we are releasing a special trial version of the game for the Steam Game Festival! Approximately 15 minutes of the game will be playable, including scenes such as “Airship”, from the beginning of the game; “Sanctuary”, an action-based setpiece; and “Town”, in which you can explore the beautiful town used as the backdrop of [i]TASOMACHI[/i]. Lose yourself in this alluring, mysterious world and get ready for the upcoming full release!

Also, from 5:00pm on February 7th (Sun./PST), for approximately one hour we will be holding an AMA (“Ask Me Anything”) Q&A session together with the game’s developer, along with a livestream of trial version gameplay.

We'll be taking questions live in real-time via the chat window, so drop in and toss us any questions you may have regarding [i]TASOMACHI[/i]!

Don't miss your chance to lose yourself in the beautiful and mysterious world of [i]TASOMACHI: Behind the Twilight[/i], and get ready for the full release coming Spring 2021!
